findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/story-advance.ts:944 and packages/main/src/handlers/story-advance.ts:1198 keep DONE cleanup on shell-interpolated git commands. The new pre-merge stray scan builds `git ls-files ... ${JSON.stringify(storyDir)}` instead of the argv-safe execFileSync form already used by cleanStrayWorktreeFiles, and the cleanup runner later interpolates branch/worktree paths into `git ${cmd}` for merge/worktree remove/branch delete. Because story prefixes, branch names, and repo/worktree paths are not mechanically constrained to shell-safe characters, command substitution or quoting characters can be interpreted by the shell in the destructive DONE cleanup path. Replace these calls with execFileSync/spawn argv arrays, and validate the detected branch equals the expected story branch before merge/delete.
